Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a bright waterfall viewpoint with a wooden deck, a waist-high wooden railing, stone steps of normal height and lush green cliffs behind her, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
